rows.sql: SELECT v_region.region_name AS region_name, v_shop.shop_id AS shop_id, v_shop.shop_name AS shop_name, SUM(v_order_paid.pay_amount) AS gmv FROM v_order_paid JOIN v_region ON v_order_paid.region_code = v_region.code JOIN v_shop ON v_order_paid.shop_id = v_shop.shop_id WHERE v_order_paid.pay_time >= %(start_ts)s AND v_order_paid.pay_status = %(pay_status)s AND v_order_paid.refund_status <> %(refund_status)s AND v_order_paid.is_test_order = %(is_test_order)s GROUP BY v_region.region_name, v_shop.shop_id, v_shop.shop_name ORDER BY region_name ASC, shop_id ASC LIMIT 1000

rows.sql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', %(anchor)s::timestamp) AS cur_start,
         date_trunc('day', %(anchor)s::timestamp) + interval '7 day' AS cur_end,
         date_trunc('day', %(anchor)s::timestamp) - interval '7 day' AS prev_start
),
cur AS (
  SELECT SUM(v_order_paid.pay_amount) AS gmv
  FROM v_order_paid, bounds
  WHERE v_order_paid.pay_status = 'paid'
    AND v_order_paid.refund_status <> 'refunded'
    AND v_order_paid.is_test_order = false
    AND v_order_paid.pay_time >= bounds.cur_start
    AND v_order_paid.pay_time < bounds.cur_end
),
prev AS (
  SELECT SUM(v_order_paid.pay_amount) AS gmv
  FROM v_order_paid, bounds
  WHERE v_order_paid.pay_status = 'paid'
    AND v_order_paid.refund_status <> 'refunded'
    AND v_order_paid.is_test_order = false
    AND v_order_paid.pay_time >= bounds.prev_start
    AND v_order_paid.pay_time < bounds.cur_start
)
SELECT 'current_7d' AS period,
       cur.gmv AS gmv,
       prev.gmv AS gmv_prev_period,
       (cur.gmv - prev.gmv) / NULLIF(prev.gmv, 0) AS gmv_mom_ratio
FROM cur, prev
LIMIT 100
